error-linked-card-not-allowed: Ushobora guhuza n'ikarata isanzwe gusa. Guhuza n'iyindi karata ihujwe, canke n'ikarata ihuza igaruka kuri iki capa, ntivyemewe kuko vyotuma amakarata adashikwako.
export-card-excel-fields: Hitamwo imirima izoshirwa mu gisohorwa ca Excel:
export-card-excel-no-disk-space: Ntibishoboka gusohora muri Excel: nta kibanza gihagije kuri disiki
user-can-not-export-card-to-pdf: Uwukoresha ntashobora gusohora ikarata muri PDF
user-can-not-export-card-to-excel: Uwukoresha ntashobora gusohora ikarata muri Excel
filter-date-range-invalid: Hitamwo amatariki abereye; itariki ya nyuma itegerezwa kuba imwe n'iyo gutangura canke ikaza inyuma yayo.
filter-due-any: Itariki iyo ari yo yose ntarengwa (harimwo n'adafise itariki)
filter-column-age-disabled: Ntunyegeze wisunze igihe ikarata imaze mu rutonde
filter-column-age-hint: Nyegeza amakarata yinjiye muri uru rutonde haheze imisi irenga iki gitigiri. Izindi ntonde n'amakarata afise amatariki yo kwinjira atazwi biguma biboneka. Guhindura ikarata ntibituma igihe imaze mu rutonde gitangura bushasha.
filter-on-desc: Uriko urayungurura amakarata kuri iki capa. Kanda hano kugira uhindure umuyungururo.
advanced-filter-card-dates-hint: Yungurura amatariki y'amakarata ukoresheje @createdAt, @receivedAt, @startAt, @dueAt, @endAt canke @listEnteredAt. Akarorero: @endAt >= '2026-01-01' canke @endAt = none. Shira izina ry'ikibanza cihariye ritangurwa na @ hagati y'utwuguruzo n'utwugarizo.
advanced-filter-description: Umuyungururo uhanitse ushoboza kwandika urukurikirane rurimwo ibi bimenyetso: == != <= >= && || ( ) Akanya gakoreshwa mu gutandukanya ibimenyetso. Ushobora kuyungurura imirima yose yihariye wandika amazina n'agaciro kayo. Nk'akarorero: Field1 == Value1. Menya: Iyo imirima canke agaciro birimwo utwanya, ubishira hagati y'utumenyetso tumwe. Nk'akarorero: 'Field 1' == 'Value 1'. Kugira usimbe ibimenyetso bimwe (' \/), ushobora gukoresha \\. Nk'akarorero: Field1 == I\'m. Ushobora kandi gufatanya ibintu vyinshi. Nk'akarorero: F1 == V1 || F1 == V2. Mu bisanzwe ibimenyetso vyose bisomwa kuva ibubamfu kuja iburyo. Ushobora guhindura urutonde ukoresheje utwugarizo. Nk'akarorero: F1 == V1 && ( F2 == V2 || F2 == V3 ). Ushobora kandi kurondera mu mirima y'inyandiko ukoresheje regex: F1 == /Tes.*/i
text-contains-trigger-description: Birahuye igihe ikarata ishizweho, canke umutwe canke ibisobanuro vyayo bihinduwe, kandi amajambo mashasha afise ibi (inyuguti nini n'intoya ntizirobanurwa).
imported-member-no-account: Umunywanyi yinjiye — nta konti ihuye na we
import-board-instruction-kanboard: Shiraho JSON yasohowe na Kanboard: ikintu gifise "columns" (canke tasks zifise column_name) n'urutonde rwa "tasks" (title, description, column_name, swimlane_name, date_due, owner, tags). Columns ziba intonde, tasks zikaba amakarata.
import-board-instruction-deck: Shiraho JSON y'icapa ca NextCloud Deck (icapa gifise "stacks", buri stack ifise "cards" zayo). Stacks ziba intonde, cards zikaba amakarata.
import-board-instruction-openproject: Shiraho JSON y'ikusanyirizo rya work-packages rya OpenProject (GET /api/v3/work_packages). Statuses ziba intonde, work packages zikaba amakarata.
import-board-instruction-issues: Shiraho urutonde rwa JSON rw'ibibazo vya __sourceName__ (__endpoint__). Ibibazo biba amakarata ashizwe mu ntonde Open / Closed.
import-board-instruction-asana: Shiraho JSON yasohowe y'ibikorwa vya Asana ({ "data": [...] } ivuye muri Asana canke GET /tasks). Ibikorwa bishirwa mu bice (memberships); ivyuzuye bija muri Done.
import-board-instruction-zenkit: Shiraho JSON yasohowe y'urutonde rwa ZenKit ({ "title", "stages":[...], "items":[...] }). Stages ziba intonde, items zikaba amakarata.
import-board-instruction-markdown: Numukiriza urutonde rw'imirimo rwa markdown (uburyo ibikoresho vya markdown-kanban nka Obsidian Kanban bikoresha): imitwe "## Izina ry'urutonde", n'ibintu "- [ ]"/"- [x]" munsi yayo. Imitwe iba ivyandikwa naho ibintu bikaba amakarita.
import-board-instruction-leo: Omekako imiterere ya Leo (idosiye .leo). Ibice vyo ku rwego rwo hejuru bihinduka intonde, ibice bibikomokako ku rwego rukurikira bigahinduka amakarata, kandi igisomwa c'igice kikaba insiguro y'ikarata. Ibice biri ku nzego zimbitse kurushiriza bihinduka intonde zo kugenzura. Ibice vyashizweko ikimenyetso vyinjizwa nk'ivyarangiye.
import-board-instruction-opml: Shiramwo incamake ya OPML, nk'uko Workflowy, Dynalist, OmniOutliner, Logseq n'ibindi bikoresho vy'incamake biyisohora. Ibintu vyo ku rwego rwa mbere bihinduka intonde, ibiri munsi yavyo bihinduka amakarata afise inyandiko nk'insiguro, ibiri hasi kurushiriza bihinduka intonde zo kugenzura. Ibintu vyarangiye vyinjizwa nk'ibiheze.
import-board-instruction-orgmode: Shiramwo idosiye ya Org mode, nk'uko Emacs, Orgzly canke Beorg biyandika. Imitwe yo ku rwego rwa mbere ihinduka intonde, imitwe yo ku rwego rwa kabiri ihinduka amakarata. TODO na DONE, ivy'imbere, ibimenyetso, SCHEDULED, DEADLINE na CLOSED biragumizwa, udusandugu n'imitwe yo hasi kurushiriza bihinduka intonde zo kugenzura.
import-board-instruction-todotxt: Omekamwo dosiye todo.txt: igikorwa kimwe ku murongo, nk'uko porogarama todo.txt n'izindi porogarama bihuye ziyandika. Ibikorwa vyarangiye ("x") bija muri Vyarangiye, +project na @context biba uturango, (A) iba akarango k'ivyihutirwa, due: na t: na vyo biba amatariki ntarengwa n'amatariki yo gutangura.
import-board-instruction-taskwarrior: Shiramwo ibiva muri task export: urutonde rwa JSON canke igikorwa kimwe ku murongo umwumwe. Ibikorwa vyarangiye bija muri Done, project na priority bihinduka ibimenyetso, annotations ihinduka ivyiyumviro, nayo depends ihinduka ukwizigira ibikorwa bibibuza kubandanya.
import-board-instruction-focalboard: Fungura dosiye ya .boardarchive uyikure mu bubiko bufinyanyije, uheze ushiremwo ibiri muri board.jsonl y’ikibaho, hamwe n’umurongo wa verisiyo canke ata wo. Ikiranga co gushira mu migwi mu kwerekana ikibaho gihinduka intonde, ibindi biranga vyo guhitamwo bigahinduka ibimenyetso, ibice vy’inyandiko n’udusandugu two gushiramwo akamenyetso bigahinduka insiguro n’urutonde rwo kugenzura, kandi ivyiyumviro bikagumaho. Amashusho n’imigereka ntivyinjizwa.
import-board-instruction-todoist: In Todoist, open the project menu and choose Export as a template, then paste the CSV file. Sections become lists, tasks become cards, sub-tasks become a checklist, notes become comments, and @labels and priorities p1 to p3 become labels.
import-board-instruction-planner: In Microsoft Planner, open the plan's menu and choose Export plan to Excel, then choose that .xlsx file. Buckets become lists and tasks become cards, with their assignees, dates, labels, checklist and description; Progress, Priority and Completed By become custom fields.
import-board-instruction-meistertask: Muri MeisterTask, kanda ku izina ry'umugambi, hitamwo Export project usohore CSV, hanyuma uyishiremwo. Ibice bihinduka intonde, ibikorwa bihinduka amakarata, hamwe n'inyandiko zavyo, itariki ntarengwa, uwahawe igikorwa n'ibimenyetso; ibikorwa vyarangiye bigumana itariki vyarangiriyeko. CSV yandikiwe kwinjizwa muri MeisterTask nayo irakora.
import-board-instruction-obsidian: Muri Obsidian, fungura idosiye y'icapa ca Kanban nka Markdown (canke ufungure idosiye .md mu gikoresho co kwandika), hanyuma uyishiremwo yose. Inzira zihinduka intonde zifise imipaka y'amakarata, amakarata agumana ibimenyetso, amatariki, ivy'imbere, imirima n'urutonde rwo kugenzura, kandi Archive ihinduka amakarata ari mu bubiko.
import-board-instruction-linear: Muri Linear, sohora ingorane nka CSV (Settings, Import / Export, Export data, canke gusohora kw'ikiraba), hanyuma ushiremwo CSV. Ingene ibintu vyifashe bihinduka intonde, imigwi ihinduka imirongo, ingorane zihinduka amakarata hamwe n'uwahawe igikorwa, ibimenyetso, amatariki, ingorane nyamukuru, ivy'imbere, igereranyo, umugambi n'ikiringo.
import-board-instruction-ticktick: Muri TickTick, fungura Settings, Account, Backup & Import hanyuma ukore ububiko bw'ingoboka, hanyuma ushiremwo idosiye CSV. Urutonde rwose rwa TickTick ruhinduka umurongo, inkingi zarwo zihinduka intonde; ibikorwa bigumana ibimenyetso, amatariki, urutonde rwo kugenzura, ivy'imbere n'ibikorwa bitoyi.
import-board-instruction-clickup: Muri ClickUp, sohora ibikorwa nka CSV (Settings, Imports / Exports, Export Items, canke gusohora kw'ikiraba ca List canke Table gifise inkingi zose), hanyuma ushiremwo CSV. Ingene ibintu vyifashe bihinduka intonde, intonde za ClickUp zihinduka imirongo, ibikorwa bihinduka amakarata hamwe n'ibikorwa bitoyi, abahawe ibikorwa, ibimenyetso, amatariki, ivy'imbere n'umwanya.
import-board-instruction-nullboard: Muri Nullboard, fungura icapa, hitamwo Export this board... mu bikubiyemo, fungura idosiye .nbx mu gikoresho co kwandika hanyuma ushiremwo ibiyirimwo. Intonde zihinduka intonde, inyandiko zihinduka amakarata: umurongo wa mbere w'inyandiko ni umutwe w'ikarata, ibisigaye ni insiguro yayo. Inyandiko itaringaniza ihabwa akarango raw. Idosiye ifise ivyapa vyinshi yinjiza icapa cayo ca mbere.
import-board-instruction-kanri: Muri Kanri, fungura Import & Export hanyuma uhitemwo Export individual board (canke Export all data), hanyuma ushiremwo idosiye .json. Inkingi zihinduka intonde, amakarata ahinduka amakarata, hamwe n'insiguro, itariki ntarengwa, ibimenyetso n'amabara; ibikorwa vy'ikarata bihinduka urutonde rwo kugenzura. Mu gusohora amakuru yose, icapa ca mbere nico cinjizwa.
import-board-instruction-planka: Andika aderesi ya Planka yawe (nk'akarorero https://planka.example.com), izina ry'ukoresha n'ijambo ry'ibanga rya Planka, hanyuma ukande «Erekana ibishobora kwinjizwa». Bikoreshwa gusa mu kuzana ikibaho kandi ntibibikwa. Hitamwo ikibaho hanyuma ukande «Zana»: WeKan iragisoma ivuye kuri API ya Planka hamwe n'intonde zaco, amakarata, insiguro, amatariki ntarengwa, ibimenyetso, abanywanyi, intonde z'ibikorwa n'ivyiyumviro, hanyuma ubandanye kwinjiza nk'uko bisanzwe. Amakarata ari mu bubiko bwa Planka yinjizwa nk'ayabitswe; ivyometseko n'amakarata ari mu gisimbo ntibyinjizwa.
import-board-instruction-mstodo: Muri Microsoft Graph Explorer (developer.microsoft.com/graph/graph-explorer), injira, emera uruhusha rwa Tasks.Read hanyuma ukoporore token uvuye ku gice ca Access token. Yishire ngaha hanyuma ukande «Erekana ibishobora kwinjizwa»; token ikoreshwa gusa muri iki kuzana kandi ntibikwa. Hitamwo intonde zose canke rumwe hanyuma ukande «Zana». Urutonde rwose rwa To Do ruhinduka urutonde n'igikorwa cose gihinduka ikarata, hamwe n'ivyandiko, amatariki ntarengwa n'ayo gutangura, intambwe nk'urutonde rwo kugenzura, imice nk'ibimenyetso, akamaro kanini n'uko bimeze nk'ibimenyetso; ibikorwa vyarangiye birabikwa. Ivyibutsa n'isubiramwo ntibyinjizwa.
import-board-instruction-kanbanflow: Muri KanbanFlow, ugurure menu y'ikibaho, uhitemwo Settings → API & Webhooks hanyuma ukoporore token ya API y'ikibaho. Shira token ngaha, ukande «Erekana ibishobora kwinjizwa», uhitemwo ikibaho hanyuma ukande «Zana»; token ikoreshwa gusa muri ico kuzana kandi ntibikwa. Inkingi zihinduka intonde, imirongo ikaguma ari imirongo; ibikorwa bigumana insiguro, ibara, ibimenyetso, itariki ntarengwa, ibikorwa bito nk'urutonde rwo kugenzura, umwanya wakoreshejwe, igereranyo, abantu n'ivyiyumviro.
import-board-instruction-basecamp: Andika ID ya konti yawe ya Basecamp (inomero iri inyuma ya basecamp.com/ muri aderesi) na token yo kwinjira (ivuye kuri porogarama ya OAuth 2 yanditswe kuri launchpad.37signals.com, canke iyo uguhuza gusanzwe gufise), ukande «Erekana ibishobora kwinjizwa», uhitemwo umugambi hanyuma ukande «Zana». Token ikoreshwa gusa muri ico kuzana kandi ntibikwa. Imbonerahamwe yose y'amakarata ihinduka umurongo n'inkingi zayo nk'intonde, intonde z'ibikorwa vyo gukora zigahinduka umurongo «To-dos»; amakarata n'ibikorwa bigumana inyandiko, amatariki, abashinzwe n'ivyiyumviro, intambwe z'ikarata zihinduka urutonde rwo kugenzura, ibikorwa vyarangiye bikabikwa.
import-board-instruction-googletasks: Ronka token yo kwinjira kuri OAuth 2.0 Playground: munsi ya Tasks API v1 hitamwo tasks.readonly, kanda Authorize APIs, hanyuma Exchange authorization code for tokens, ukoporore token yo kwinjira. Yishire ngaha hanyuma ukande «Erekana ibishobora kwinjizwa», uhitemwo intonde z'ibikorwa zose canke rumwe, hanyuma «Zana». Token ikoreshwa gusa muri iki kuzana kandi ntibikwa. Intonde z'ibikorwa zihinduka intonde, ibikorwa bigahinduka amakarata, hamwe n'ivyandiko, imihuza n'itariki ntarengwa; ibikorwa bito bihinduka urutonde rwo kugenzura, ibikorwa vyarangiye vyinjizwa nk'ivyabitswe.
import-board-instruction-googlekeep: API ya Google Keep ni iya konti za Google Workspace gusa. Ronka token yo kwinjira ya OAuth 2.0 ifise urugero https://www.googleapis.com/auth/keep.readonly (muri OAuth 2.0 Playground nimba umuyobozi wa Workspace yawe abitanguye uruhusha, canke ivuye kuri konti y'igikorwa ifise uruhusha ku ndangarubuga yose), uyishire, ukande «Erekana ibishobora kwinjizwa» hanyuma «Zana». Token ikoreshwa gusa muri iki kuzana kandi ntibikwa. Ivyandiko vy'amajambo bihinduka amakarata mu rutonde «Notes», ivyandiko vy'urutonde rwo kugenzura bigahinduka amakarata mu rutonde «Lists» n'ibintu vyabyo nk'urutonde rwo kugenzura. Ivyandiko biri mu gisimbo, ivyometseko no gusangira ntibyinjizwa.
api-import-desc: Bizane uvuye ku gikorwa ukoresheje konti yawe bwite. Ivyo wandika ngaha bikoreshwa gusa muri iki kuzana kandi ntibibikwa.
api-import-fetched: Vyazanywe. Raba abanywanyi bari munsi hanyuma winjize.
api-import-nothing: Nta kintu co kwinjiza kiriho kuri iyi konti.
import-board-instruction-pivotal: Muri Pivotal Tracker, fungura agace MORE k'umugambi hanyuma uhitemwo Export CSV (canke uhitemwo inkuru uhitemwo Bulk Actions, CSV), hanyuma ushiremwo CSV. Ingene inkuru yose yifashe bihinduka urutonde, inkuru zihinduka amakarata hamwe n'ubwoko bwazo n'ibimenyetso, ba nyenezo, uwazisavye, amatariki, ivyiyumviro, ibikorwa n'ibibuza; Estimate ihinduka Story points, ibiringo bihinduka sprints.
import-board-instruction-tasksorg: Muri Tasks.org, fungura Settings, Backups hanyuma uhitemwo Export tasks, hanyuma ushiremwo ibiri muri iyo dosiye .json. Intonde zihinduka intonde, ibikorwa bihinduka amakarata hamwe n'inyandiko zavyo, ibimenyetso, amatariki, ivyiyumviro n'ibikorwa bitoyi; ibikorwa vyarangiye bigumana itariki vyarangiriyeko, ivy'imbere bihinduka umurima wihariye.
import-board-instruction-monday: Muri monday.com, fungura ibikubiyemo vy'icapa, hitamwo More actions na Export board to Excel (hamwe n'amakuru mashasha n'ibintu bitoyi nimba ubishaka), hanyuma uhitemwo iyo dosiye .xlsx. Inkingi Status ihinduka intonde, imigwi ihinduka imirongo; abantu, amatariki, ikiringo n'ibimenyetso bigumana ibibanza vyavyo, izindi nkingi zihinduka imirima yihariye, amakuru mashasha ahinduka ivyiyumviro.
import-board-instruction-superproductivi: Muri Super Productivity, fungura Settings, hanyuma Sync & Backup, hitamwo Export Data hanyuma ushiremwo ibiri mu dosiye sp-backup .json. Umugambi wose uhinduka umurongo, ibikorwa bihinduka amakarata muri To Do, In Progress, Backlog canke Done, hamwe n'inyandiko zavyo, ibimenyetso, itariki ntarengwa, umwanya wakoreshejwe n'ibikorwa bitoyi; ibikorwa biri mu bubiko bihinduka amakarata ari mu bubiko.
import-board-instruction-taiga: Muri Taiga, fungura Admin > Project > Export hanyuma upakurure ivyo umugambi ufise (banza ufungure idosiye .json.gz), hanyuma ushiremwo JSON yayo. Ingene inkuru z'abakoresha zifashe bihinduka intonde, inkuru z'abakoresha zihinduka amakarata hamwe n'ibikorwa vyazo nk'ibikorwa bitoyi, epics n'ingorane bironka imirongo yavyo, kandi sprints, ibimenyetso, ivyiyumviro n'ibiranga vyihariye biraza. Ivyometse ntivyinjizwa.
import-board-instruction-vikunja: Muri Vikunja, fungura Settings, hitamwo Data Export hanyuma upakurure idosiye .zip ikurungikira, hanyuma uhitemwo iyo dosiye, canke ushiremwo data.json iyirimwo. Ibitebo vya Kanban bihinduka intonde, ibikorwa bihinduka amakarata, hamwe n'ibimenyetso, abahawe ibikorwa, amatariki, insiguro, intonde z'ibikorwa nk'intonde zo kugenzura n'ivyiyumviro; ivy'imbere, ijana ry'ivyakozwe n'ivyaheze bihinduka imirima yihariye. Ivyometse ntivyinjizwa.
import-board-instruction-quire: Muri Quire, fungura ibikubiyemo vy'umugambi hanyuma uhitemwo Export CSV, hanyuma ushiremwo CSV. Ingene ibintu vyifashe bihinduka intonde, ibikorwa bihinduka amakarata, hamwe n'ibikorwa bitoyi nk'amakarata y'abana, abahawe ibikorwa, ibimenyetso nk'uturango, amatariki yo gutangura, ntarengwa n'ayo kurangiza, insiguro n'ivy'imbere nk'umurima wihariye. Ivyiyumviro n'ivyometse ntibiri muri CSV ya Quire.
import-board-instruction-wrike: Muri Wrike, sohora umugambi canke ububiko muri Excel, canke wuzuze icitegererezo ca Excel co kwinjiza ca Wrike, hanyuma uhitemwo iyo dosiye .xlsx. Imirongo y'ububiko n'umugambi ihinduka imirongo y'icapa, Status ihinduka intonde, ibikorwa bihinduka amakarata, hamwe na Key yavyo, igikorwa nyamukuru, abahawe ibikorwa, amatariki yo gutangura n'ayo guheza, ivyo bishingiyeko n'insiguro; Priority, Duration n'izindi nkingi zihinduka imirima yihariye.
import-board-instruction-teamwork: Muri Teamwork.com, uzuza icitegererezo ca Excel co kwinjiza ibikorwa (Tasklist, Task, Description, Assign to, Start date, Due date, Priority, Estimated time, Tags, Status) ugibike nka .xlsx, hanyuma uhitemwo iyo dosiye. Intonde z'ibikorwa zihinduka intonde, ibikorwa bihinduka amakarata; igikorwa gitangurwa na -, # canke > gihinduka igikorwa gitoyi c'igikorwa kiri hejuru yaco (--, ## canke >> ku rwego rumwe rwo hasi kurushiriza). Abahawe ibikorwa, amatariki n'ibimenyetso bigumana ibibanza vyavyo; Priority, Estimated time na Complete bihinduka imirima yihariye.
import-board-instruction-businessmap: Muri Businessmap (yahora yitwa Kanbanize), fungura Advanced Search, hitamwo Configure results kugira utore inkingi, upakurure idosiye ya Excel, hanyuma uhitemwo iyo dosiye .xlsx. Inkingi zisomwa ku mazina yazo y'Icongereza (Title, Column, Lane, Owner, Deadline ...): nimba konte yawe ikoresha urundi rurimi, banza uhindure umurongo w'imitwe ube mu Congereza. Column ihinduka intonde, Lane ihinduka imirongo; ba nyenezo, ibimenyetso, ibara, amatariki, ivyiyumviro n'imirongo y'ibikorwa nyamukuru bigumana ibibanza vyavyo, Priority, Size, Type n'izindi nkingi zihinduka imirima yihariye.
import-board-instruction-redmine: Muri Redmine, fungura Issues z'umugambi, hitamwo Also available in: CSV hasi y'urutonde, utore inkingi (All columns, hamwe na Description) hanyuma usohore, hanyuma ushiremwo CSV. Redmine yita inkingi mu rurimi rwawe, rero shira ururimi rwawe mu Congereza muri My account imbere yo gusohora. Ingene ibintu vyifashe bihinduka urutonde, ingorane zihinduka amakarata, hamwe na tracker nk'akarango, uwahawe igikorwa, uwanditse, amatariki, igikorwa nyamukuru n'ingorane zifitaniye isano; priority, category, target version, estimated time, % Done n'imirima yihariye bihinduka imirima yihariye.
import-board-instruction-notion: Muri Notion, fungura ububiko bw'amakuru nk'urupapuro rwuzuye, hitamwo ••• na Export, utore Markdown & CSV, hanyuma uhitemwo idosiye .zip ipakururwa, canke CSV imwe y'ububiko bw'amakuru iyirimwo, canke ushiremwo iyo CSV. Inkingi yitwa Status ihinduka intonde (iyo itariho, inkingi ya mbere isa n'iyo guhitamwo niyo ibikora, kandi raporo yo kwinjiza ivuga iyo ari yo); imirongo ihinduka amakarata hamwe n'umutwe wayo, ibimenyetso nk'uturango, abantu nk'abanywanyi, amatariki, n'inyandiko y'urupapuro nk'insiguro; izindi nkingi zihinduka imirima yihariye. Amasano, amashusho n'ivyometse ntivyinjizwa.
import-board-instruction-plane: Muri Plane, fungura Workspace Settings, hitamwo Exports, sohora imigambi nka JSON, CSV canke Excel hanyuma upakurure idosiye .zip, hanyuma uhitemwo iyo dosiye, canke idosiye imwe iyirimwo, canke ushiremwo JSON canke CSV. Ingene ibintu vyifashe bihinduka intonde, imigambi ihinduka imirongo, ingorane zihinduka amakarata hamwe n'ikiziranga cazo, nyamukuru, abahawe ibikorwa, uturango, amatariki, imirongo n'ivyiyumviro; ivy'imbere, igereranyo, ikiringo na module bihinduka imirima yihariye. Ivyo Plane isohora ntibirimwo insiguro canke ivyometse, rero ntibyinjizwa.
import-board-instruction-trello: Ku capa cawe ca Trello, ja kuri 'Menu', hanyuma 'More', 'Print and Export', 'Export JSON', maze ukoporore inyandiko ivuyemwo.
import-board-instruction-csv: Shiraho Comma Separated Values(CSV)/ Tab Separated Values (TSV) zawe.

globalSearch-instructions-description: Ukurondera gushobora kubamwo abakoresha kugira gutomore ibisubizo. Abakoresha bagenwa mu kwandika izina ry'umukoresha n'agaciro bitandukanywa n'utudomo tubiri. Nk'akarorero, `list:Blocked` igabanya ukurondera ku makarata ari mu rutonde rwitwa *Blocked*. Iyo agaciro karimwo utwanya canke ibimenyetso bidasanzwe gategerezwa gushirwa hagati y'utwuguruzo (nk'akarorero `__operator_list__:"To Review"`).
globalSearch-instructions-operator-board: `__operator_board__:<title>` - amakarata yo ku bicapo bifise *<title>* yatanzwe
globalSearch-instructions-operator-list: `__operator_list__:<title>` - amakarata yo mu ntonde zifise *<title>* yatanzwe
globalSearch-instructions-operator-swiml: `__operator_swimlane__:<title>` - amakarata yo mu mirongo ifise *<title>* yatanzwe
globalSearch-instructions-operator-label: `__operator_label__:<color>` `__operator_label__:<name>` - amakarata afise akarango gahuye na *<color>* canke *<name>
globalSearch-instructions-operator-org: `__operator_org__:<display name|short name>` - amakarata yo ku capa cashinzwe ishirahamwe *<name>*
globalSearch-instructions-operator-team: `__operator_team__:<display name|short name>` - amakarata yo ku capa cashinzwe umugwi *<name>*
globalSearch-instructions-operator-due: `__operator_due__:<n>` - amakarata afise igihe ntarengwa gushika ku misi *<n>* kuva ubu. `__operator_due__:__predicate_overdue__ itondeka amakarata yose yarengeje itariki ntarengwa.
globalSearch-instructions-operator-creat: `__operator_created__:<n>` - amakarata yaremwe haciye imisi *<n>* canke mike
globalSearch-instructions-operator-modif: `__operator_modified__:<n>` - amakarata yahinduwe haciye imisi *<n>* canke mike
globalSearch-instructions-status-all: `__predicate_all__` - amakarata yose yashizwe n'atashizwe mu bubiko
globalSearch-instructions-status-public: `__predicate_public__` - amakarata yo ku bicapo vya rusangi gusa
globalSearch-instructions-status-private: `__predicate_private__` - amakarata yo ku bicapo vyigenga gusa
globalSearch-instructions-operator-has: `__operator_has__:<field>` - aho *<field>* ari kimwe muri `__predicate_attachment__`, `__predicate_checklist__`, `__predicate_description__`, `__predicate_start__`, `__predicate_due__`, `__predicate_end__`, `__predicate_assignee__` canke `__predicate_member__`. Gushira `-` imbere ya *<field>* birondera aho agaciro katari muri uwo murima (nk'akarorero `has:-due` irondera amakarata adafise itariki ntarengwa).
globalSearch-instructions-operator-sort: `__operator_sort__:<sort-name>` - aho *<sort-name>* ari kimwe muri `__predicate_due__`, `__predicate_created__` canke `__predicate_modified__`. Kugira utunganye uva hejuru umanuka, shira `-` imbere y'izina ry'itunganywa.
globalSearch-instructions-operator-limit: `__operator_limit__:<n>` - aho *<n>* ari igitigiri cuzuye kirenga zero cerekana amakarata yerekanwa ku rupapuro rumwe.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-2:
Abakoresha basa bahuzwa na *CANKE*. Amakarata ahuye n'ikigenderwako ico ari co cose arasubizwa.
`__operator_list__:Available __operator_list__:Blocked` isubiza amakarata ari mu rutonde urwo ari rwo rwose rwitwa *Blocked* canke *Available*.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-3: Abakoresha batandukanye bahuzwa na *KANDI*. Amakarata ahuye n'abakoresha bose batandukanye gusa ni yo asubizwa. `__operator_list__:Available __operator_label__:red` isubiza gusa amakarata yo mu rutonde *Available* afise akarango *red*.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-3-2: Imisi ishobora kugenwa nk'igitigiri cuzuye kirenga canke kiri munsi ya zero, canke hakoreshejwe `__predicate_week__`, `__predicate_month__`, `__predicate_quarter__` canke `__predicate_year__` ku kiringo ca none.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-4: Ukurondera igisomwa ntigutandukanya inyuguti nkuru n'into.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-5: Ku buryo mburabuzi amakarata yo mu bubiko ntaronderwa.

mongodb-compact-description: Inyuma yo gukura amadosiye muri MongoDB GridFS, dosiye y'ububiko bw'amakuru kuri disiki ntigabanuka ubwayo. Gukoresha Compact bigarura umwanya wabohowe mu kwandika bushasha amakuru y'ikusanyirizo. Bikoreshe gusa inyuma y'uko kwimura amadosiye menshi kurangiye.

Mu migwi y'amakopi, amakopi yose y'inyongera abanza gukorerwa Compact (ubwa vyo), hanyuma irya mbere. Mu migwi y'ikopi imwe ikoreshwa kuri oplog (imiterere isanzwe ya Meteor), irya mbere gusa ni yo ikorerwa Compact.

accounts-lockout-known-users: Ibigenwa vy'abakoresha bazwi (izina ry'uwukoresha ni ryo, ijambobanga ni ribi)

s3-minio-storage-description: Ububiko bw'ibintu bujanye na S3: AWS S3, MinIO, Cloudflare R2, Backblaze B2, Wasabi, DigitalOcean Spaces n'ibindi.
s3-force-path-style-description: Birakenewe kuri MinIO no kuri seriveri nyinshi zihuye na S3 zitari iza AWS.
azure-connection-string-description: Si ngombwa: koresha igisomwa cose co guhuza mu gishingo c'izina rya konti n'urufunguzo.
database-migration-description: Imura amakuru ashingiye ku gisomwa (vyose kiretse imigereka n'amashusho y'abakoresha biguma muri sisitemu y'amadosiye) hagati ya MongoDB na FerretDB v1 (SQLite). Ubundi bubiko bw'amakuru butegerezwa kuba buriko burakora kandi bushikwako (ivyambu mburabuzi: FerretDB mongodb://127.0.0.1:27018, MongoDB mongodb://127.0.0.1:27019; hindura ukoresheje WEKAN_FERRETDB_URL / WEKAN_MONGODB_URL). Niwarangira, erekeza MONGO_URL ku bundi bubiko bw'amakuru maze wongere utangure WeKan (kuri Snap: snap set wekan database=ferretdb canke =mongodb).
database-migrate-to-ferretdb: Imurira amakuru y'igisomwa muri FerretDB v1 (SQLite)
database-migration-confirm: Kopa amakusanyirizo yose ashingiye ku gisomwa muri __db__? Imigereka n'amashusho y'abakoresha biri muri sisitemu y'amadosiye ntibikorwako. Ububiko bw'amakuru bugenewe kwakira butegerezwa kuba buriko burakora.
sandstorm-migration-description: Igihe WeKan ikorera mu grain ya Sandstorm, ububiko bwayo bwa kera bwa MongoDB 3 bwimurirwa muri FerretDB v1 (SQLite) ku gutangura kwa mbere, kandi imigereka n'amashusho y'abakoresha bikurwa mu bubiko bw'amakuru bikajanwa mu bubiko files/attachments na files/avatars bwa grain. Ibi vyerekana ko iryo yimurwa ryagenze neza n'umwanya wo kuri disiki amadosiye ya kera adahinduwe ya MongoDB agikoresha muri grain, kandi bikagufasha kuyafuta kugira ubohore umwanya.
sandstorm-delete-raw-mongodb: Futa amadosiye adahinduwe y'ububiko bwa MongoDB
sandstorm-delete-raw-mongodb-description: Inyuma y'iyimurwa ryagenze neza, amakuru aba muri FerretDB no muri sisitemu y'amadosiye, rero amadosiye ya kera adahinduwe y'ububiko bwa MongoDB 3 ashobora gufutwa kugira habohorwe umwanya wa disiki ya grain. Ivyo ntibishobora gusubizwa inyuma.
sandstorm-delete-raw-mongodb-confirm: Futa amadosiye adahinduwe y'ububiko bwa MongoDB 3 kugira ubohore umwanya wa disiki? Amakuru yaramaze kwimurirwa muri FerretDB no muri sisitemu y'amadosiye. Ivyo ntibishobora gusubizwa inyuma.
sandstorm-raw-mongodb-deleted: Amadosiye adahinduwe y'ububiko bwa MongoDB yafuswe, habohowe
features-desc: Ubushobozi bwo guhitamwo iyi WeKan itanga. Ubushobozi butashizweko akamenyetso buranyegezwa ku mugaragarire wa bose. Amakuru yabwo arabikwa kandi uburenganzira ntibuhinduka.
feature-views-overview-desc: Ibiharuro, gushira mu migwi hisunzwe uwashinzwe igikorwa, umugambi w'inzira, icapa c'igenzura n'icapa kinini.
feature-views-gantt-desc: Uburyo butatu bwo kubona igicapo ca Gantt.
feature-views-scrum-desc: Urutonde rw'ibikorwa vy'igicuruzwa, ibiringo bigufi vy'akazi, icegeranyo c'ikiringo c'akazi n'umuvuduko.
feature-views-flow-charts-desc: Akazi gasigaye n'akaheze, urugendo rw'akazi rwegeranijwe, igihe c'uruziga n'ico gushikiriza, urugero rw'akazi kaheze, igihe akazi kamaze, intambamyi, Monte Carlo n'izindi ngero z'ingene ibikorwa bigenda.
feature-approval-required: Reka ubushobozi bwongerwa n'amavugurura ya WeKan buzimye gushika umuyobozi abwuguruye
feature-preview-admins: Abayobozi babona ubushobozi buzimye kugira ngo babanze babugerageze
feature-pilot-users: Abakoresha b'igerageza na bo babona ubushobozi buzimye
card-field-visibility-desc: Imirima ya Board Settings / Card ivyapa bishobora kwerekana. Umurima udashizweko akamenyetso uhishwa ku karata yose, ku karata gatoyi kose no muri Board Settings / Card y'icapa cose. Nta makuru y'ikarata canke ikigenwa c'icapa bihinduka, kandi kuwushirako akamenyetso kandi bisubiza icapa cose nk'uko cari gitunganijwe. Urutonde rw'imirima ni urw'icapa cose ubwaco.
cards-loading-description: WeKan ishira amakarata y'icapa ubwayo: icapa kinini (kirenze urugero rw'ubunini) gishira gusa amakarata aboneka ubu (kuzunguruka kutagira iherezo) hamwe n'igitigiri gihinduka ubwo nyene, kugira kigume cihuta kandi gikoreshe ububiko n'urubuga bike; ibicapo bitoyi vyo bigashira ikarata yose kugira bikore mu buryo bworoshe kandi bwuzuye. Nta co kugena gihari. Abayobozi barashobora guhatira uburyo bakoresheje CARDS_LOADING (all/lazy/auto) na CARDS_LOADING_LAZY_THRESHOLD.
cards-loading-lazy-note: Ugushira amakarata make kuracageragezwa: ibitigiri vy'amakarata n'imbibe za WIP ni vyo, ariko uburyo bwa Calendar/Table/Gantt no guhitamwo vyinshi vyerekana gusa amakarata amaze gushirwa. Subira ushire ibicapo vyuguruye inyuma yo guhindura ibi.
render-links-as-plain-text-description: Igihe bikora, amahuza yose (amahuza ya markdown nka [label](url) n'ibirango vya HTML <a href> bidahinduwe) yama yerekanwa nk'igisomwa gisanzwe kidakandwako mu mirima yose y'igisomwa gikize (imitwe y'ibicapo n'amakarata, insiguro, insasanuro, intonde zo kugenzura, n'ibindi). Ibi birabuza amahuza akandwako ashobora guhenda. Ku buryo mburabuzi birazimye, amahuza rero aguma akandwako.
always-show-code-as-text: Yama werekana kode yose nk'igisomwa gisanzwe
always-show-code-as-text-description: Igihe bikora, igisomwa gikize nticigera cerekanwa nka markdown canke HTML: isoko yose yama yerekanwa nk'igisomwa gisanzwe mu mirima yose y'igisomwa gikize (imitwe y'ibicapo n'amakarata, insiguro, insasanuro, intonde zo kugenzura, n'ibindi). Ibi vyerekana ibinyegejwe — insasanuro za HTML (<!-- -->), iyo amahuza ya markdown yerekeza, JavaScript n'iyindi kode yose — kode yose rero yama iboneka, ntikandwako kandi ntikora. Ku buryo mburabuzi birazimye, markdown rero yerekanwa uko bisanzwe.
disable-all-import-description: Igihe bikora, ubushobozi bwose bwo kwinjiza burazimwa: kwinjiza icapa kivuye muri WeKan JSON, Trello, CSV/Excel, Jira, Kanboard, NextCloud Deck, OpenProject, GitHub, GitLab, Gitea na Forgejo, hamwe no gukopa icapa. Amahitamwo yo kwinjiza aranyegezwa kandi seriveri ikanka ubusabe bwose bwo kwinjiza. Ku buryo mburabuzi birazimye.
disable-all-export-description: Igihe bikora, ubushobozi bwose bwo gusohora burazimwa: gusohora icapa nka WeKan JSON, CSV, Excel, Kanboard, canke muri NextCloud Deck / OpenProject / GitHub / GitLab / Gitea / Forgejo, hamwe no gusohora umugereka umwe. Amahitamwo yo gusohora aranyegezwa kandi seriveri ikanka ubusabe bwose bwo gusohora. Ku buryo mburabuzi birazimye.
disable-import-avatars-description: Igihe bikora, amashusho y'abakoresha ntiyigera yinjizwa. Ibi birimwo ukwinjiza WeKan JSON, ukwinjiza Trello no guhuza amashusho ava ku batanga umwidondoro bo hanze igihe co kwinjira (LDAP, OIDC/OAuth2). Amazina n'ayandi makuru biracakinjizwa; amashusho y'abakoresha gusa ni yo asimbukwa. Ku buryo mburabuzi birazimye.
disable-export-avatars-description: Igihe bikora, amashusho y'abakoresha ntiyigera ashirwa mu gusohora icapa (gusohora WeKan JSON na CSV). Amazina y'abakoresha n'ayandi makuru aracasohorwa; amashusho y'abakoresha gusa ni yo arekwa. Ku buryo mburabuzi birazimye.
anonymize-import-users-description: Igihe bikora, kwinjiza icapa ca WeKan JSON bisubiriza izina ry'uwukoresha, izina ryuzuye n'inyuguti z'intango vy'uwukoresha wese yinjiye n'ibisubirizi bifise ibitigiri (user1, user2, ...), bigakuraho ishusho yiwe kandi bikongera kwandika aho @username ivugwa (n'imirima y'uwabisavye / uwabishinze) mu makarata n'insasanuro vyinjijwe. Nta mwidondoro nyakuri w'uwukoresha wo ku capa c'isoko ubikwa. Ijambo "uwukoresha" rikurikira ururimi rw'uwinjiza. Ku buryo mburabuzi birazimye.
anonymize-export-users-description: Igihe bikora, gusohora icapa bisubiriza izina ry'uwukoresha, izina ryuzuye n'inyuguti z'intango vy'uwukoresha wese asohorwa n'ibisubirizi bifise ibitigiri (user1, user2, ...), bigakuraho ishusho yiwe kandi bikongera kwandika aho @username ivugwa (n'imirima y'uwabisavye / uwabishinze) mu makarata n'insasanuro. Dosiye isohowe nta mwidondoro nyakuri w'uwukoresha itwara. Ijambo "uwukoresha" rikurikira ururimi rw'uwusohora. Ku buryo mburabuzi birazimye.
anonymize-account-confirm-popup: Igihe bikora, gusohora icapa bisubiriza izina ry'uwukoresha, izina ryuzuye n'inyuguti z'intango vy'uwukoresha wese asohorwa n'ibisubirizi bifise ibitigiri (user1, user2, ...), bigakuraho ishusho yiwe kandi bikongera kwandika aho @username ivugwa (n'imirima y'uwabisavye / uwabishinze) mu makarata n'insasanuro. Dosiye isohowe nta mwidondoro nyakuri w'uwukoresha itwara. Ijambo "uwukoresha" rikurikira ururimi rw'uwusohora. Ku buryo mburabuzi birazimye.
disable-activities-description: Igihe bikora, ivyandikwa mu ruhererekane rw'ibikorwa ntivyigera vyandikwa kandi ntivyerekanwa ahantu na hamwe (ku ruhande rw'icapa no mu gice c'ibikorwa vy'ikarata). Nta mateka y'uwakoze iki abikwa. Ku buryo mburabuzi birazimye.
disable-notifications-description: Igihe bikora, WeKan ntiyigera irungika imenyesha zo gukurikirana (muri porogarama, imeyili canke izindi serivisi) ku gikorwa ico ari co cose. Ibikorwa birashobora kuguma vyandikwa (kiretse na vyo bizimijwe hejuru); imenyesha gusa ni zo zihagarikwa. Ku buryo mburabuzi birazimye.
disable-watch-description: Igihe bikora, ubushobozi bwo gukurikirana burazimwa — abakoresha ntibashobora kwiyandikisha ku bicapo, intonde canke amakarata kugira baronke imenyesha, kandi igerageza ryose ryo guhindura urugero rwo gukurikirana rirankwa. Ku buryo mburabuzi birazimye.
backup-description: Bika kopi y'Imigereka, Amashusho y'abakoresha na/canke Amakuru (amakusanyirizo yose ashingiye ku gisomwa atari imigereka canke amashusho y'abakoresha). .zip irungikwa ubwo nyene mu bubiko bwatowe — nta dosiye y'igihe gito — nka backup/YYYY/MM/DD/HH_MM_SS/backup.zip, irimwo YYYY_MM_DD-HH_MM_SS/attachments, /avatars na /data. Ububiko bwo mu gicu (S3/MinIO, Azure, GCS) bukoresha imyirondoro yagenwe mu duce twabwo tw'ububiko.
backup-scope-description: Porogarama yose canke Ishirahamwe rimwe. Kopi yo gukingira y'Ishirahamwe irimwo ibicapo vyaryo n'ibiri kuri vyo vyose, harimwo imigereka y'ivyo bicapo — ariko nta makonti y'abakoresha canke ibigenwa vya porogarama, kuko bisangiwe n'Amashirahamwe yose. Kugarura kopi y'Ishirahamwe kwandika gusa ku bicapo iryo Shirahamwe rifise.
continuous-backup-description: Irungika ihinduka ryose ryo mu bubiko bw'amakuru, imigereka, amashusho y'abakoresha n'inyandiko z'ibikorwa mu bubiko bumwe mu masegonda make, kugira ngo bishoboke kugarura ivyariho igihe cose. Ikorana na kopi yo gukingira itegekanijwe, ikora amakopi yuzuye.
continuous-backup-enabled: Koresha kopi yo gukingira ibandanya kuri iyi seriveri
continuous-backup-target: Ububiko bwo gushiramwo (inzira yuzuye, ku yindi disiki, mu bubiko busangiwe ku muhora canke ahahujwe na rclone)
continuous-backup-engine-sqlite: Impapuro za SQLite (impapuro zahindutse mu kiringo cose categekanijwe)
continuous-backup-engine-none: Nta moteri y'ububiko bw'amakuru ishobora gukora kuri iyi seriveri
continuous-backup-encrypt: Nyegeza kopi yo gukingira ukoresheje kode (AES-256-GCM)
continuous-backup-key-file: Dosiye y’urufunguruzo rwo kunyegeza ukoresheje kode (inzira yuzuye iri hanze y’ububiko bwo gushiramwo; indome 64 zo mu buryo bw’ibiharuro bushingiye kuri 16 canke interuro y’ibanga ifise n’imiburiburi indome 16). Bika kopi: iyo dosiye itariho, kopi yo gukingira ntishobora kugarurwa.
continuous-backup-upload-none: Nta hantu (mu bubiko bwo gushiramwo gusa)
continuous-backup-upload-prefix: Ububiko bwa dosiye buri mu gitebo co kubikamwo
continuous-backup-restore-sqlite: Dosiye y'ububiko bw'amakuru SQLite (ikorerwa iruhande ya kopi yo gukingira, ntiyigera yandikwa hejuru ya dosiye iriko irakoreshwa)
continuous-backup-apply-on-restart: Koresha ububiko bw’amakuru SQLite bwongeye kwubakwa igihe gikurikira sisitemu izosubira gutangura (ububiko bw’amakuru bwa kera busubirijwe buzobikwa)
continuous-backup-restore-confirm: Garura urukurikirane rwa kopi rwatowe ku gihe catowe? Kopi yo gukingira ibandanya irahagarara akanya gato mu gihe co kugarura.
continuous-backup-saved: Amatunganyo ya kopi yo gukingira ibandanya yabitswe
backup-restore-select-first: Banza uhitemwo kopi yo gukingira ku rutonde.
backup-restore-confirm: Garura kopi yo gukingira yatowe? Imigereka/amashusho y'abakoresha yandikwa muri sisitemu y'amadosiye, amakuru akandikwa mu bubiko bw'amakuru hakurikijwe uburyo bwatowe.
gcs-key-filename: Inzira ya dosiye y'urufunguzo rwa konti ya serivisi
gcs-key-filename-description: Si ngombwa: inzira ya dosiye y'urufunguzo JSON rwa konti ya serivisi kuri seriveri.
gcs-credentials-description: Si ngombwa: nimanika urufunguzo JSON rwa konti ya serivisi. Sigaza ubusa kugira ukoreshe dosiye y'urufunguzo canke imyirondoro mburabuzi.

blockly-MATH_RANDOM_FLOAT_TOOLTIP: Subiza igice c'impwemwe kiri hagati ya 0.0 (irimwo) na 1.0 (itarimwo).
blockly-MATH_RANDOM_INT_TITLE: igitigiri cuzuye c'impwemwe kuva kuri %1 gushika kuri %2
blockly-MATH_RANDOM_INT_TOOLTIP: Subiza igitigiri cuzuye c'impwemwe kiri hagati y'imipaka ibiri yatanzwe, irimwo.
blockly-MINIMAP_ARIA_LABEL: Ikarata ntoya y'aho gukorera. Koresha utubuto tw'imyampi kugira wimure aho gukorera.
blockly-PASTE_ALL_FROM_BACKPACK: Shiramwo amabloke yose avuye mu gikapu
blockly-PROCEDURES_CALLRETURN_TOOLTIP: Kora ifunsiyo '%1' yagenywe n'uwukoresha hanyuma ukoreshe ivyo isohora.
blockly-PROCEDURES_CALL_DISABLED_DEF_WAR: Ntibishoboka gukora ifunsiyo '%1' yagenywe n'uwukoresha kuko bloke y'insobanuro yayo izimye.
blockly-PROCEDURES_DEF_DUPLICATE_WARNING: Imburi: Iyi funsiyo ifise ingingo zisubiwemwo.
blockly-PROCEDURES_IFRETURN_TOOLTIP: Nimba agaciro ari ukuri, subiza agaciro ka kabiri.
blockly-PROCEDURES_IFRETURN_WARNING: Imburi: Iyi bloke ishobora gukoreshwa gusa mu nsobanuro y'ifunsiyo.
blockly-PROCEDURES_MUTATORCONTAINER_TOOL: Ongerako, kura, canke usubire utondeke ivyinjizwa vy'iyi funsiyo.
blockly-SCREENREADER_HINT: Koresha utubuto tw'imyampi kugira utembere. Fyonda %1 kugira ufungure canke uzimye uburyo bw'igisoma-kirahure.
blockly-SCREENREADER_MODE_DISABLED: Uburyo bw'igisoma-kirahure burazimye, fyonda %1 kugira ubufungure
blockly-SCREENREADER_MODE_ENABLED: Uburyo bw'igisoma-kirahure burafunguye, fyonda %1 kugira ubuzimye
blockly-TEXT_CHANGECASE_TOOLTIP: Subiza kopi y'inyandiko mu bundi bwoko bw'inyuguti.
blockly-TEXT_CHARAT_TOOLTIP: Gisubiza inyuguti iri ku kibanza catanzwe.
blockly-TEXT_COUNT_TOOLTIP: Harura incuro inyandiko iboneka mu yindi nyandiko.
blockly-TEXT_CREATE_JOIN_TOOLTIP: Ongerako, kura, canke usubire utondeke ibice kugira usubire utunganye iyi bloke y'inyandiko.
blockly-TEXT_GET_SUBSTRING_END_FROM_END: gushika ku nyuguti # uhereye ku mpera
blockly-TEXT_GET_SUBSTRING_START_FIRST: ronka igice c'inyandiko uhereye ku nyuguti ya mbere
blockly-TEXT_GET_SUBSTRING_START_FROM_EN: ronka igice c'inyandiko uhereye ku nyuguti # uhereye ku mpera
blockly-TEXT_GET_SUBSTRING_START_FROM_ST: ronka igice c'inyandiko uhereye ku nyuguti #
blockly-TEXT_INDEXOF_OPERATOR_FIRST: rondera aho inyandiko iboneka ubwa mbere
blockly-TEXT_INDEXOF_OPERATOR_LAST: rondera aho inyandiko iboneka ubwa nyuma
blockly-TEXT_INDEXOF_TOOLTIP: Gisubiza ikibanza inyandiko ya mbere iboneka ubwa mbere/ubwa nyuma mu nyandiko ya kabiri. Gisubiza %1 iyo inyandiko itabonetse.
blockly-TEXT_ISEMPTY_TOOLTIP: Gisubiza ukuri iyo inyandiko yatanzwe ari ubusa.
blockly-TEXT_JOIN_TOOLTIP: Rema igice c'inyandiko uhuza ibintu bingana uko ushaka.
blockly-TEXT_LENGTH_TOOLTIP: Gisubiza igitigiri c'inyuguti (harimwo n'ibihanga) mu nyandiko yatanzwe.
blockly-TEXT_PRINT_TOOLTIP: Erekana inyandiko, igitigiri canke ikindi gaciro catanzwe.
blockly-TEXT_REPLACE_TOOLTIP: Subirira aho inyandiko iboneka hose mu yindi nyandiko.
blockly-TEXT_REVERSE_TOOLTIP: Hindukiza urutonde rw'inyuguti ziri mu nyandiko.
blockly-TEXT_TRIM_OPERATOR_BOTH: kura ibihanga ku mpande zompi za
blockly-TEXT_TRIM_OPERATOR_LEFT: kura ibihanga ku ruhande rw'ibubamfu rwa
blockly-TEXT_TRIM_OPERATOR_RIGHT: kura ibihanga ku ruhande rw'iburyo rwa
blockly-TEXT_TRIM_TOOLTIP: Subiza kopi y'inyandiko yakuweko ibihanga ku mpera imwe canke zompi.
blockly-VARIABLE_ALREADY_EXISTS_FOR_ANOT: Igihinduka citwa '%1' gisanzwe kiriho ku bundi bwoko: '%2'.
blockly-VARIABLE_ALREADY_EXISTS_FOR_A_PA: Igihinduka citwa '%1' gisanzwe kiriho nk'ingingo mu funsiyo '%2'.
blockly-WORKSPACE_CONTENTS_BLOCKS_ONE: Ikirundo kimwe c'amabloke%2 kiri aho gukorera.
blockly-WORKSPACE_LABEL_MUTATOR_WORKSPAC: Aho gukorera h'igikoresho co guhindura ibloke
blockly-WORKSPACE_SEARCH_INPUT_LABEL: Rondera aho gukorera. Fyonda Enter ku gihuye gikurikira, Shift+Enter ku gihuye cabanje. Fyonda Escape kugira wugare kurondera no kuja ku gihuye kiriho.
r-blocks-help: Huza imbarutso imwe n'igikorwa kimwe. Kurura amabloke uyakuye mu bikoresho. Koresha igikoresho c'ifishi ku mahitamwo y'imbere.
r-blocks-unavailable: Amakuru y'itegeko ntaboneka. Koresha igikoresho c'ifishi kugira usuzume iri tegeko.
r-blocks-invalid: Huza imbarutso imwe gusa n'igikorwa kimwe. Kura amabloke atahujwe canke arenze imbere yo kubika.
r-blocks-conflict: Iri tegeko ryahindutse igihe wariko urahindura. Subira ufungure itegeko ryabitswe imbere yo kubika.
r-blocks-permission: Uburenganzira bw'umuyobozi w'icapa burakenewe kugira uhindure amategeko.
scrum-policy-doneLists: Ikarata iri mu rutonde rw'ubwoko Done
scrum-releases-select-help: Ikarata ishobora kuba mu masohorwa menshi. Fata Ctrl (Cmd kuri Mac) kugira uhitemwo arenze rimwe; yakureho yose kugira ukure ikarata mu masohorwa yose.
scrum-select-sprint: Hitamwo sprint kugira urabe raporo yayo.
scrum-backlog-help: Tondeka akazi ukurikije urwego mu bisigaye. Shira amakarata muri sprint yateguwe canke iriko irakora.
scrum-event-daily: Inama ya Scrum ya misi yose
scrum-no-closed-sprints: Nta foto ya sprint yugawe iboneka.
scrum-report-help: Raporo zigumana ibigereranyo bivuye mu mafoto ya sprint. Ibigereranyo bitazwi biharurwa ukwavyo; si ibigereranyo vya zero. Gereranya umuvuduko gusa hagati y'ibipimo vy'igereranyo n'amategeko bihuye.
scrum-confirm-close: Ugara iyi sprint hanyuma ubike ivyavuyemwo? Amakarata ataraheza azokwimurirwa aho wahisemwo.
scrum-confirm-cancel: Hagarika iyi sprint? Amakarata yayo agumana ubunywanyi bwayo gushika ashizwe ahandi.
scrum-partial-report: Raporo y'igice: amakarata ushinzwe ubu gusa ni yo arimwo.
scrum-partial-snapshot: Iyi sprint irimwo igice gusa c'ifoto y'intango.
scrum-rollover-progress: Kwimura amakarata ya sprint imbere: __done__ muri __total__
scrum-history-job-running: Gusubiza inyuma canke gusubira gukora ihinduka rinini: __done__ mu mirongo y’amateka __total__
scrum-history-job-failed: Gusubiza inyuma canke gusubira gukora ihinduka rinini vyahagaze. Subira ukande gusubiza inyuma canke gusubira gukora kugira ngo ubandanye:
scrum-daily-observations: Ibigize akazi n'akazi gasigaye ku musi (ivyabonywe)
scrum-daily-observations-help: Inkingi yose yerekana ivyabonywe vya mbere vyanditswe ku musi wa UTC, ku gihe kigaragara. Imisi ibuze ntiyerekanwa. Ivyo vyabonywe ntibyandika impinduka zose canke ngo vyerekane igiteranyo c'impera y'umusi. Ibigereranyo bitazwi si zero. Koresha igikorwa Export c'iki gice ku vyabonywe vya misi yose; igikorwa Export c'umurongo w'ibikoresho gisohora ivyavuye muri sprint.
scrum-daily-truncated: Ivyabonywe 366 vya vuba gusa ni vyo vyerekanwa.
scrum-daily-empty: Nta vyabonywe vya misi yose vyanditswe kuri iyi sprint.
scrum-scope-history: Ingano y’igikorwa n’igikorwa gisigaye, ihinduka ku rindi
scrum-scope-history-help: Vyasubiye kwubakwa hakoreshejwe kahise k’icapa kuva ikiringo c’igikorwa gitanguye: umurongo umwe ku hinduka ryose ry’amakarata y’ikiringo, ibigereranyo canke igikorwa carangiye.
scrum-scope-history-inconsistent: Kahise ntigasubira kurema ishusho y’uko iki kiringo c’igikorwa cari kimeze: amahinduka amwe yakozwe atanditswe muri kahise, ni co gituma ibi bipimo bituzuye.
scrum-scope-history-truncated: Amahinduka ya mbere gusa ni yo yashoboye gusomwa; ugusubira kwubaka ntikwuzuye.
scrum-scope-history-empty: Nta mahinduka kuva ikiringo c’igikorwa gitanguye.
scrum-scope-cause-lifecycle: Ikarata yashizwe mu bubiko canke yagarukanywe
scrum-daily-observations-export-help: Ivyabonywe vya mbere vyanditswe ku musi wose wa UTC; imisi ibuze ntiyerekanwa. Ivyabonywe ntibyandika impinduka zose canke igiteranyo c'impera y'umusi. Ibigereranyo bitazwi si zero.
scrum-import-pending: Kwinjiza Scrum ntikwarangiye. Guhindura Scrum no gusohora raporo ntibishoboka.
scrum-import-recovery-hint: Kwinjiza kwahagaze kubera gusubira gutangura gushobora guhezwa hano iyo kwamaze guhagarara. Nimba umugambi wakwo utabitswe wose, gushobora guhagarikwa gusa; ivyo nta co bihindura ku capa.
scrum-import-into-board: Injiza ugutegura kwa Scrum kuri iki capa
scrum-import-into-board-hint: Hitamwo idosiye y'icapa ca WeKan yasohowe canke idosiye yo kwimura Scrum. Ama-sprint n'amasohorwa iki capa gisanzwe gifise birahuzwa, ntibisubirwamwo. Amakarata ahuzwa na ID, canke n'inomero y'ikarata n'umutwe; amakarata adahuye arandikwa agasigara uko ari. Banza urabe imbere kugira umenye ivyo bizohinduka.
scrum-import-preview-sprints: Ama-sprint: __created__ mashasha, __matched__ asanzwe kuri iki capa, __skipped__ atinjijwe
scrum-import-preview-releases: Amasohorwa: __created__ mashasha, __matched__ asanzwe kuri iki capa, __skipped__ atinjijwe
scrum-import-preview-cards: Amakarata: __updated__ yo gushirwa ku gihe, __unchanged__ adahindutse, __unmatched__ adahuye
scrum-import-preview-nothing: Nta co guhindura: iki capa gisanzwe gifise uku gutegura.
scrum-import-into-board-done: Ugutegura kwa Scrum kwinjijwe kandi kwanditswe muri Kahise.
scrum-import-card-ambiguous: Ikarata ihuye n'amakarata arenze imwe kuri iki capa: __reference__
scrum-import-card-on-another-board: Ikarata ni iy'ikindi capa kandi yasigaye uko iri: __reference__
scrum-import-record-ambiguous: Sprint canke isohorwa bihuye n'ibirenze kimwe kuri iki capa: __reference__
scrum-import-record-not-imported: Sprint, isohorwa canke ikibaye ntivyashoboye kwinjizwa: __reference__
sync-conflict-hint: Hitamwo agaciro kuri buri tati. Sync isubiramwo inyuma ya buri hitamwo. Nta kintu kirungikwa ku buryo bw'inkomoko.
sync-conflict-refresh: Subira ukoreshe Sync kugira usuzume uduciro turiho.
sync-conflict-review-complete: Amakarata ushinzwe yasuzumwe. Nta matati y'imirima asigaye. Sync y'urutonde rwose ntiyakozwe.
sync-conflict-detach-hint: Kura gusa uguhuza kwa Sync kw'iyi isubiwemwo. Ibiyirimwo biguma muri WeKan.
sync-conflict-archive: Gushira mu bubiko kwabujijwe n'amakarata mato akora
sync-conflict-archive-hint: Ikintu c'inkomoko nticakiriho, ariko amakarata mato akora abuza gushira mu bubiko. Gumana iyi karata ngaha ukuyeko uguhuza kwayo kwa Sync. Amakarata mato ntahinduka.
sync-conflict-creation-hint: Gumana ikarata yabanje uko iri hanyuma urema ikarata nshasha ya Sync muri uru rutonde. Gusubiramwo bikoresha iyo isubirira.
sync-preview-saved: Bishingiye ku bigenwa vyabitswe. Sync ubu nyene iraronka kandi igasuzuma inkomoko kandi.
sync-preview-unavailable: Bika inkomoko ya Sync imbere yo gusaba kuraba imbere.
sync-preview-blocked: Tunganya amatati ari hepfo imbere yo gusuzuma umugambi w'impinduka.
sync-preview-scope: Ibiharuro vyerekeye imirima y'inkomoko yatunganijwe. Ayandi makuru ashobora gusigwa n'igisoma c'inkomoko.
sync-source-scope: Inzira zitondeka mu migwi aho imirima iboneka mu bintu vy'inkomoko. Ibintu bitahujwe bivugwa vyose hamwe; uduciro twavyo ntitwerekanwa.
sync-source-occurrences: Aho imirima canke ibintu vyavuzwe biboneka
sync-source-truncated: Raporo igarukira ku nzira 100 n'amazina y'imirima yagabanijwe.
sync-source-omitted: Ahandi biboneka hatari mu nzira zerekanwa
sync-report-retention: Ivyakozwe 20 vya vuba. Raporo zibikwa imisi 30.
sync-report-partial: Ivyakozwe vyanse canke bitarangiye vyoba vyahinduye amakarata amwe. Izi raporo ntizibandanya canke ngo zisubize inyuma ivyakozwe.
sync-report-unfinished: Biriko birakorwa canke vyahagaritswe; ivyavuyemwo ntivyanditswe
sync-report-completed-with-warnings: Vyarangiye hamwe n'imirima yasizwe canke yahinduwe
sync-report-unavailable: Raporo z'ivyakozwe zisaba uburenganzira bwo kwandika ku rutonde rwose na seriveri iboneka.
sync-recovery-description: Raporo za Sync zabitswe zo mu misi 30 iheze. Rondera ukoresheje ID y'icapa canke y'urutonde. Ivyavuyemwo bitarangiye vyoba bikiriko birakorwa canke vyahagaritswe. Subira ufungure kugira usuzume kandi; izi raporo ntizishobora kubandanya canke gusubiza inyuma impinduka.
sync-recovery-unavailable: Ntibishoboka gusoma isuzuma rya Sync. Suzuma uburenganzira bw'umuyobozi n'uko seriveri iboneka.
sync-estimate-field-hint: Hitamwo umurima w'ibitigiri ufise ID y'umurima wa Jira n'igipimo c'igereranyo, nk'uko vyaremwe n'ukwinjiza kwa Jira guhujwe. Impinduka zo ngaha zisuzumwa nk'amatati. Uduciro tw'inkomoko tubuze ntitwitabwako; null itomoye ikuraho agaciro kahujwe.
sync-estimate-field-gitlab-hint: Uburemere canke ikigereranyo c’umwanya ca GitLab vyandikwa mu kibanza c’ibiharuro wahisemwo. Amahinduka yo ng’aha asuzumwa nk’ukutumvikana; ikibazo kitagira uburemere gihanagura agaciro gafatanijwe na co.
email-recovery-description: Umurongo umwe ku muntu wese yakira. Rondera ukoresheje ID y'uwukoresha. Ibiri mu butumwa n'ibibanza vy'imeyili vy'uwakira ntivyerekanwa. Guhagarika gatoyi bifata ubutumwa busanzwe n'ubwo muri kazoza; Kubandanya bisubira kugerageza kurungika ubutumwa buri ku murongo ubu. Guhagarika burundu bikuraho ubutumwa bwashizwe ku murongo gushika ku gihe c'igisabo. Nimba kurungika bikiriko birakorwa, subira ugerageze mu kanya. Ubutumwa bwatanguye kurungikwa ntibushobora kugarurwa, kandi irungikwa ritazwi neza uko ryagenze rishobora gusubirwamwo. Ibitagenze neza burundu n'ubutumwa bwashitse ku rugero ntarengwa rw'igerageza bigumaho kugira bisuzumwe. Gusubira kugerageza ubutumwa butarungitswe neza bitangura ikiringo gishasha c'igerageza kandi bigumana ihagarikwa rya gatoyi risanzwe.
email-recovery-attempts: Igitigiri kinini kuruta ibindi co gusubira kugerageza
email-recovery-oldest: Igihe bwashizwe ku murongo ubwa mbere
email-recovery-cancel: Hagarika burundu ubutumwa buri ku murongo
email-recovery-empty: Nta butumwa buri ku murongo kandi nta bakira bahagarikiwe kurungikirwa gatoyi.
email-recovery-unavailable: Ntibishoboka gusoma umurongo w'imeyili. Suzuma uburenganzira bw'umuyobozi n'uko seriveri iboneka.
email-recovery-busy: Kurungika canke ikindi gikorwa c'umurongo biriko birakorwa. Vugurura hanyuma usubire ugerageze mu kanya.
email-recovery-failed: Igikorwa nticashoboye kwemezwa. Vugurura umurongo kandi usubire ugerageze igikorwa kimwe nimba bikenewe.
email-recovery-superseded: Igikorwa gishasha c'uwujejwe ibikorwa casubiriye iki gisabo. Herekanwa uko umurongo umeze ubu.
email-recovery-confirm-cancel: Guhagarika burundu ubutumwa bwose buri ku murongo ubu bugenewe uyu wakira? Ibirimwo bizokurwaho kandi ntibishobora kugarurwa. Ubutumwa bushasha bwakozwe inyuma y'iki gisabo buzogumaho.
email-recovery-retry: Subira ugerageze kurungika ubutumwa butarungitswe neza
email-failure-delivery-unconfirmed: Gushikiriza ntikwashoboye kwemezwa; suzuma imbere yo gusubiramwo
sync-time-estimate-hint: Ibigereranyo vy'umwanya bikoresha imirima y'ibitigiri y'umwanya w'intango/usigaye yaremwe n'ukwinjiza kwa Jira. Umurima umwe gusa uhuye utegerezwa kuba kuri iki capa. Impinduka zo ngaha zisuzumwa nk'amatati; uduciro tw'inkomoko tubuze ntitwitabwako kandi null itomoye ikuraho agaciro.
sync-planning-hint: Sprint n'amasohorwa bihuzwa gusa igihe Scrum ifunguye kuri iki capa. Sprint canke isohorwa bibuze biremwa kuri iki capa, hamwe n'amatariki inkomoko itanga; ibisanzweho bihuzwa mbere na mbere na ID y'inkomoko, hanyuma n'izina. Impinduka yo gutegura yo ngaha iguma gushika inkomoko ihinduye ugutegura kw'iyo ngorane, kandi Sync ya mbere ntiyigera ikuraho ugutegura.
activity-recovery-description: Amakuru ataraheza asubirwamwo mu buryo bwikora. Suzuma ibikorwa bibuze canke vyahindutse imbere yo gusubiramwo. Gusubiramwo ntikwigera gusubira kurema igikorwa.
activity-recovery-retrying: Biriko birashira ku gihe ugushikiriza amakuru…
activity-recovery-busy: Uwundi mukozi ariko arakora kuri aya makuru. Subira ufungure hanyuma ugerageze kandi.
activity-recovery-denied: Uburenganzira bw'uwakira canke ivyo ahitamwo ku makuru ntibikiremera gushikiriza.
activity-recovery-source-unavailable: Igikorwa c'intango kirabuze canke carahindutse. Nta kintu casubiwe kuremwa.
activity-recovery-failed: Ntibishoboka kurangiza gushikiriza amakuru. Akazi karindiriye karagumijwe.
activity-recovery-paused: Gushikiriza amakuru y'ibikorwa kwahagaritswe akanya gato.
activity-recovery-control-conflict: Aya makuru yarahindutse kuva yafungurwa. Suzuma uko ibintu vyifashe ubu imbere yo kugerageza kandi.
activity-recovery-control-failed: Ntibishoboka kwemeza ikigenwa co gushikiriza. Subira ufungure hanyuma usuzume uko kimeze ubu.
activity-recovery-cancel-confirm: Hagarika burundu gushikiriza gusigaye kuri iki gikorwa? Ntibishobora kubandanywa. Imeyili zamaze gushirwa ku murongo n'amakuru yashikirijwe ntibisubizwa inyuma.
rule-email-recovery-description: Suzuma igerageza ryanditswe ryo kurungika imeyili z'amategeko. Igerageza ritaremezwa rishobora kuba rikibandanya kurungika canke ryarahagaritswe. Iki cegeranyo ntigisubira kurungika kandi ntigihagarika kurungika.
rule-email-recovery-empty: Nta gerageza ryo kurungika imeyili z'amategeko rihuye n'uku kurondera.
rule-email-recovery-unavailable: Ntibishoboka gufungura ukugerageza kurungika imeyili kw'amategeko. Subira ufungure kugira ugerageze kandi.
rule-email-recovery-actions-hint: WeKan ntiyigera yisubiriza kurungika imeyili itaremezwa. Gusubira kurungika bikorwa ku bakira bataremezwa gusa. Shira ikimenyetso c'uko yarungitswe nimba uzi ko yashitse, canke uhagarike ukurungika.
rule-email-recovery-wait: Ukurungika kwa mbere gushobora kuba kukibandanya. Urashobora gufata ingingo inyuma ya __time__.
rule-email-recovery-resend-confirm: Wosubira kurungikira iyi meyili abakira bataremezwa? Umuntu wese seriveri yiwe y'imeyili yayakiriye itabimenyesheje WeKan azoyironka kabiri.
rule-email-recovery-mark-sent-confirm: Woshira kuri iyi meyili ikimenyetso c'uko yarungikiwe bose? Bikore gusa nimba uzi ko yashitse.
rule-email-recovery-drop-confirm: Wohagarika ukurungika iyi meyili? Ntizorungikirwa abakira bataremezwa.
rule-email-resolution-too-early: Ukurungika kwa mbere gushobora kuba kukibandanya. Subira ugerageze mu nyuma.
rule-email-resolution-resend-in-flight: Ugusubira kurungika kwabanje gushobora kuba kukibandanya. Subira ugerageze mu nyuma.
rule-email-resolution-nothing-to-resend: Uwuyakira wese yamaze kwemezwa. Ahubwo shira ikimenyetso c'uko yarungitswe.
rule-email-resolution-resend-uncertain: Seriveri y'imeyili ntiyishuye. Imeyili yasubiye kurungikwa ishobora kuba yashitse canke itashitse; yerekanwa nk'ikibandanya.
rule-email-resolution-busy: Uwundi muyobozi ariko aratorera umuti iyi meyili. Subira ugerageze mu kanya gato.
rule-email-resolution-command-changed: Imeyili yabitswe ntigihuye n'iri gerageza, rero ntishobora gutorerwa umuti hano.
rule-email-resolution-attempt-invalid: Ivyabitswe kuri iri gerageza ntivyemewe, rero ntirishobora gutorerwa umuti hano.
rule-email-resolution-failed: Ntivyashobotse gutorera umuti iyi meyili. Subira ufungure urupapuro maze wongere ugerageze.
rule-email-legacy-description: Izi meyili z'amategeko zateguwe n'ubwoko bwa kera bwa WeKan butanditse aho ibizirimwo vyavuye, rero WeKan ntizozirungika ubwayo. Banza usuzume ko uwashizeho itegeko agifise uburenganzira bwo kwinjira, maze usubire guhuza imeyili kugira itegurwe bushasha hakurikijwe ikarata uko iri ubu, canke uyihebe.
rule-email-legacy-reason-details-snapsho: Ibisobanuro vy'ikarata vyo mu bwoko bwa kera
rule-email-legacy-rebind-confirm: Wosubira gutegura iyi meyili ukurikije ikarata uko iri ubu? Ibiyirimwo bishobora gutandukana n'ivyari vyateguwe imbere.
rule-email-legacy-unavailable: Ntivyashobotse kuzana imeyili z'amategeko zirindiriye gusuzumwa. Subira ufungure urupapuro kugira wongere ugerageze.
rule-email-legacy-access-denied: Uwashizeho itegeko ntagifise uburenganzira bwo kwinjira kuri iyi karata, canke itegeko ryarahindutse, rero imeyili ntishobora gusubira guhuzwa. Urashobora kuyiheba.
rule-email-legacy-source-changed: Igikorwa catumye iyi meyili itegurwa carahindutse, rero ntishobora gusubira guhuzwa. Urashobora kuyiheba.
rule-email-legacy-source-unavailable: Ikarata iyi meyili yavuyeko ntikiboneka, rero ntishobora gusubira guhuzwa. Urashobora kuyiheba.
rule-email-legacy-plan-unavailable: Ishirwa mu ngiro ry'itegeko ryateguye iyi meyili ntirikibitswe, rero ntishobora gusubira guhuzwa. Urashobora kuyiheba.
rule-email-legacy-attempt-exists: Iyi meyili yamaze kurungikwa, kugeragezwa kurungikwa canke guhebwa.
rule-email-legacy-failed: Ntivyashobotse kurangiza iki gikorwa. Subira ufungure urupapuro maze wongere ugerageze.
stuck-sync-operation-heading: Ibikorwa vya List Sync bidashobora gusubirwamwo
stuck-sync-operation-description: Igikorwa cose muri ibi vya List Sync vyabitswe cahagaze hagati kandi ntigishobora kurangizwa, kuko urutonde rwaco rwakuweho, rwasubiwe kuremwa canke rwasubiwe gutunganywa, canke uwagitanguye yatakaje uburenganzira bwo kwandika. Igihe kimwe kirindiriye, urwo rutonde ntirushobora gukora Sync. Guta kugira urutonde rusubire rukore Sync: impinduka zamaze gushirwa mu ngiro ziraguma, impinduka zisigaye zabitswe ntizigera zandikwa, kandi Sync ikurikira isubira kugereranya urutonde n'inkomoko yarwo.
stuck-sync-operation-reason-scope-change: Urutonde rwakuweho, rwasubiwe kuremwa canke ibigenwa vyarwo vya Sync vyarahindutse
stuck-sync-operation-reason-access-denie: Uwagitanguye ntagifise uburenganzira bwo kwandika ku rutonde rwose
stuck-sync-operation-reason-trigger-unkn: Vyabitswe na verisiyo ya kera ya WeKan hatanditswe ico cagitanguje
stuck-sync-operation-replayable-now: Gishobora gusubirwamwo ubu kandi kizorangira ubwaco, rero ntigishobora gutabwa.
stuck-sync-operation-discard-confirm: Guta iki gikorwa ca List Sync cabitswe? Impinduka camaze gushira mu ngiro ziraguma; izisigaye ntizigera zandikwa. Urutonde ruca rushobora gukora Sync kandi.
stuck-sync-operation-empty: Nta bikorwa vya List Sync birindiriye gusuzumwa.
stuck-sync-operation-truncated: Ibya kera 50 gusa ni vyo vyerekanwa. Guta bimwe hanyuma usubire ufungure kugira urabe ibindi.
stuck-sync-operation-unavailable: Ntibishoboka gufungura ibikorwa vya List Sync. Subira ufungure kugira ugerageze kandi.
stuck-sync-operation-not-stuck: Iki gikorwa ntikirasangwa caheze, rero ntigishobora gutabwa.
stuck-sync-operation-replayable: Iki gikorwa gishobora gusubirwamwo ubu kandi kizorangira ubwaco, rero nticatawe.
stuck-sync-operation-busy: Uru rutonde ruriko rurakora Sync ubu nyene. Gerageza kandi mu kanya.
stuck-sync-operation-failed: Ntivyashobotse kurangiza iki gikorwa. Subira ufungure urupapuro maze wongere ugerageze.
interrupted-import-heading: Ukwinjiza ivyapa kwahagaze imbere yo kurangira
interrupted-import-description: Ukwinjiza icapa kwose muri uku kwahagaze hagati - seriveri yasubiye gutangura, canke ukwinjiza kwanse - kugasiga icapa kituzuye. Ukwinjiza ntikushobora kubandanywa, kuko idosiye y'inkomoko yakwo itabikwa. Gumana icapa uko kiri, canke ugite hanyuma usubire winjize idosiye. Guta bikuraho icapa uku kwinjiza kwaremye n'ibiri kuri co vyose, harimwo n'ivyacongeweko kuva ico gihe.
interrupted-import-state-discarding: Biriko biratabwa; subira uta kugira birangire
interrupted-import-scrum: Intambwe yaco ya Scrum ifise aho ihagarara hayo (__state__, __next__ muri __total__ intambwe). Nimba ugumanye icapa, rangiza canke uyite uciye mu kugarura ukwinjiza kwa Scrum kw'icapa.
interrupted-import-counts: imirongo __swimlanes__, intonde __lists__, amakarata __cards__, intonde zo kugenzura __checklists__, ivyiyumviro __comments__, ivyometse __attachments__
interrupted-import-keep-confirm: Gumana iki capa kituzuye uko kiri? Nta kintu gikurwaho, kandi ukwinjiza ntikugisubira kwandikwa ngaha.
interrupted-import-discard-confirm: Guta uku kwinjiza? Icapa kwaremye n'ibiri kuri co vyose bikurwaho burundu.
interrupted-import-empty: Nta kwinjiza ivyapa kwahagaritswe kurindiriye gusuzumwa.
interrupted-import-truncated: Ibya kera 50 gusa ni vyo vyerekanwa. Gumana canke uje ibimwe hanyuma usubire ufungure kugira urabe ibindi.
interrupted-import-unavailable: Ntibishoboka gufungura ukwinjiza ivyapa kwahagaritswe. Subira ufungure kugira ugerageze kandi.
interrupted-import-foreign-board: Icapa gifise iyi id nticaremwe n'uku kwinjiza, rero nticakozweko.
interrupted-import-scrum-busy: Intambwe yaco ya Scrum iracariko irandikwa canke iragarurwa. Gerageza kandi mu minota mike.
interrupted-import-failed: Ntivyashobotse kurangiza iki gikorwa. Subira ufungure urupapuro maze wongere ugerageze.
saml-login-not-started: Uku kwinjira ukoresheje SAML ntikwatanguriye muri iyi tabi y’umucukumbuzi. Subira winjire.
history-request-pending-undo: Seriveri ntiremeza ugusubiza inyuma ihinduka ryawe rya nyuma.
history-request-pending-redo: Seriveri ntiremeza ugusubira gukora ihinduka ryawe rya nyuma.
history-request-hint: Gusubira kugerageza bisubiramwo ca gisabo nyene, rero ntibishobora kwigera bisubiza inyuma irindi hinduka.
scrum-history-checkpoint-stuck: Gusubiza inyuma, gusubiramwo canke kugarura impinduka za Scrum vyahagaze kubera amatati. Guhindura Scrum kuri iki capa kurabujijwe gushika bitunganijwe.
scrum-history-checkpoint-counts: Impinduka __applied__ muri __total__ zanditswe, __pending__ ntizanditswe, __conflicted__ zahinduwe n'uwundi muntu kuva ico gihe.
scrum-history-checkpoint-hint: Gusubiza inyuma bisubiza icanditswe cose cahindutse uko cari kimeze imbere; bitangwa gusa iyo ata wundi yahinduye ivyo vyanditswe kuva ico gihe. Kugumana icapa uko kiri bikuraho igikorwa cahagaze kandi nta canditswe gihindura. Uko biri kwose, vyandikwa muri Admin Panel, Problems, Recovery.
scrum-history-checkpoint-discard-confirm: Gumana icanditswe cose uko kimeze ubu, harimwo n'impinduka igikorwa cahagaze camaze kwandika?
scrum-history-checkpoint-ask-admin: Umuyobozi w'icapa ashobora kubisubiza inyuma canke kugumana icapa uko kiri.
login-setting-clear-secret: Kuraho agaciro kabitswe mu kibaho c'umuyobozi
login-setting-after-restart: Bitangura gukora inyuma yo gusubira gutanguza WeKan
login-setting-env-only: Ibidukikije vya seriveri gusa ni vyo bishiraho ibi. Vyerekanwa ngaha mu buryo bwo gusoma gusa.
email-to-card-description: Imeyili irungitswe kuri aderesi y'icapa cawe ihinduka ikarata kuri ico capa.
email-to-card-webhook: URL ya webhook yinjira y'uwutanga imeyili (Mailgun, SendGrid, Postmark canke MIME relay itatunganijwe)
email-to-card-imap-accounts: Udusandugu tw'iposita twa IMAP two gusoma
email-to-card-sandstorm-board: Icapa imeyili irungikiwe iyi grain ijako
email-to-card-sandstorm-board-none: Nta na kimwe - imeyili zifise ikimenyetso c'icapa mu mutwe gusa
email-to-card-sandstorm-subject: Shira ibi mu mutwe kugira ushike kuri iki capa mw'izina ryawe:
email-to-card-your-address: Aderesi yawe ya imeyili y'iki capa
email-to-card-address-private: Yigumane mu ibanga: uwuyifise wese ashobora kwongerako amakarata mw'izina ryawe.
email-to-card-off-admin-off: Kwakira imeyili ntivyashizweho mu Kibaho c'umuyobozi.
email-to-card-off-board-off: Umuyobozi w'icapa ntiyafunguye imeyili kuri iki capa.
email-to-card-off-member-off: Wazimije aderesi z'ivyapa vyawe mu Bigenwa vy'umunywanyi.
email-to-card-off-sandstorm-no-session: Grain ntiragira aderesi ya imeyili yayo. Subira ufungure urupapuro.
email-to-card-off-not-authorized: Ukeneye uburenganzira bwo kwandika kuri iki capa.
inbound-domain-invalid: Iryo si izina rya domeni ryemewe.
inbound-account-invalid: Agasandugu k'iposita ka IMAP gakeneye izina rya seriveri ryemewe.
feature-views-email-desc: Icapa nk'agasandugu k'amabaruwa: urutonde rw'imeyili ni Izinjiye, intonde ni amasanduku, ibimenyetso ni ibimenyetso, abanywanyi bandika kandi bishura imeyili bakoresheje aderesi y'icapa.
email-view-not-receiving: Iki capa ntikirakira imeyili. Yifungure mu Mategeko y'ivyibutso vy'icapa → Imeyili ija ku ikarata.
email-view-invalid-address: Imwe muri aderesi si aderesi y'imeyili ibereye.
email-view-too-many: Imeyili nyinshi cane zarungitswe mu isaha iheze. Subira ugerageze hanyuma.
feature-views-chat-desc: Icapa nk'ikibanza c'ikiyago: ibibanza vy'akazi, ivyapa, imirongo, intonde n'amakarata nk'igiti c'imiyoboro, ikarata hagati n'ivyiyumviro vyayo nk'ubutumwa bw'ikiyago.
chat-view-pick-card: Hitamwo ikarata mu miyoboro kugira uyibone ng'aha.
chat-view-no-messages: Nta butumwa buraba. Andika ubwa mbere.
feature-views-column-sets-desc: Amakarata amwe mu migwi myinshi y'inkingi ifise amazina - ukurikije irangira, ibanze, intambwe canke ikindi kintu cose - yimurwa hagati y'inkingi mu kuyikwega.
feature-rule-suggestions-desc: Menu y'ikibaho → Amategeko atanga amategeko akuye ku vyo abantu bakora n'amaboko kenshi.
feature-board-summary-desc: Menu y'ikibaho → Incamake yerekana ivyo umuntu wese yakoze ku kibaho ku musi canke mu ndwi iheruka, n'ibirenze igihe.
feature-since-last-visit-desc: Menu y'ikibaho → Kuva uheruka kugenda herekana ivyo abandi bahinduye ku kibaho.
feature-search-phrases-desc: Kurondera hose gutahura amajambo nka "amakarata yanje yarenze igihe".
column-sets-empty: Nta migwi y'inkingi irabaho. Umuyobozi w'icapa arashobora kuwurema: uwuhe izina, hanyuma wongeremwo inkingi zawo.
feature-views-version-control-desc: Icapa nk'igikurikirana ry'ingorane rya GitHub canke Gitea: amakarata nk'ingorane, ibimenyetso n'intambwe nkuru, ivyiyumviro nk'ikiganiro, ivyometse nk'amadosiye, n'amateka y'icapa hamwe no gusubiza inyuma.
vcs-no-milestones: Nta ntambwe nkuru irahari. Ikimenyetso gifise itariki ntarengwa ni intambwe nkuru.
vcs-no-list: Iki capa nta rutonde canke umurongo gifise ku ngorane.
card-qr-code-desc: Uyisuzume kugira wugurure iyi karata kuri terefone canke tablette.
card-qr-code-too-long: Umuhora w'iyi karata ni muremure cane ku kode ya QR.
vcs-no-wiki: Nta wiki iraba. Kwinjiza ishirahamwe rya GitHub bizana hano wiki y'ububiko.
github-org-import-desc: Ububiko bwose bw'ishirahamwe canke bw'uwukoresha buhinduka ikibaho cabwo, gifunguwe muri Board View / Version Control: ingorane zabwo n'ivyiyumviro, ibimenyetso n'amadosiye yazo, ivyasohowe vyabwo, imigendekere y'akazi ya GitHub Actions nk'Amategeko, na wiki yabwo.
github-org-import-token-hint: Irakenewe ku bubiko bwihariye no ku rugero rwa API rurerure. Ikoreshwa gusa igihe kwinjiza biriko birakorwa kandi ntizigera ibikwa.
github-org-import-actions: Imigendekere y'akazi ya GitHub Actions nk'Amategeko
github-org-import-result: Ingorane %s, ivyasohowe %s, amategeko %s, impapuro za wiki %s
github-org-import-owner-invalid: Andika izina ry'ishirahamwe canke ry'uwukoresha, canke aderese yaryo ya GitHub.
optional-apis-desc: REST API zisa n'iz'abandi bakurikirana ibibazo (trackers), kugira ngo porogarama zabo n'inyandiko (scripts) zabo zishobore gukoresha iyi WeKan nk'ishingiro ryazo (backend): ivyo zibitse bibikwa muri WeKan, ku vyapa vya WeKan. Imwe imwe iguma izimye gushika ishizweko akamenyetso ng'aha. Nta n'imwe ifise uburenganzira bwayo: umukiriya yinjira akoresheje token ya API ya WeKan, kandi ashobora kubona no guhindura gusa ivyo uwo muntu ashobora kubona no guhindura muri WeKan. Zose zikenera ko WeKan REST API iba yatswe (WITH_API=true). Aderesi iri munsi ya imwe imwe ni yo umukiriya akoresha nka seriveri yiwe.
optional-api-trello-desc: Porogarama n'inyandiko (scripts) zanditswe ku bwa REST API ya Trello (nk'akarorero Trellinator) zikora na WeKan: ivyapa, intonde, amakarata, ibimenyetso, abanywanyi, ivyiyumviro n'intonde zo kugenzura. Token ya Trello ni token ya API ya WeKan. Gufuta ikarata biyijana mu bubiko muri WeKan.
optional-api-jira-desc: Abakiriya ba REST API v2 ya Jira bakora na WeKan: umugambi ni icapa (urufunguzo rwawo ni urufunguzo rw'icapa), ingorane ni ikarata (DEV-7), uko ibintu vyifashe ni urutonde, kandi ihinduka rihimura ikarata. Ukurondera kwemera JQL yoroshe: project, status, assignee = currentUser(), text na ORDER BY. Injira ukoresheje token ya API ya WeKan nk'ijambo ry'ibanga. Gufuta ingorane biyijana mu bubiko.
optional-api-github-desc: Abakiriya ba REST API ya GitHub ku ngorane bakora na WeKan: ububiko bw'imigambi (repository) ni icapa, ingorane ni ikarata, hamwe n'ibimenyetso, intambwe nkuru (ibimenyetso bifise itariki ntarengwa), ivyiyumviro, kandi zuguruye canke zugaye nk'uko biri muri Uko icapa kiboneka / Igenzura rya verisiyo. Token ni token ya API ya WeKan.
optional-api-gitea-desc: Abakiriya ba REST API ya Gitea na Forgejo ku ngorane bakora na WeKan, nk'uko API ihuye na GitHub ikora: ububiko bw'imigambi ni icapa kandi ingorane ni ikarata. Token ni token ya API ya WeKan.
bots-none: Nta roboti zirabaho. Roboti ni igikoresho gikora kuri seriveri yawe - umukozi wa AI, igikorwa ca CI, inyandiko-porogaramu - iki capa giha amakarata.
bot-not-found: Iyo roboti ntiri kuri iki capa.
bot-option-not-found: Iyo nyishu si imwe mu zo roboti yatanze.
webhook-internal-hosts-desc: Webhooks zisohoka ntizishobora gushika ku maderesi ari ku rubuga rwa WeKan nyene, kugira ngo ntihagire uwerekeza webhook y'ikicapa ku gikorwa c'imbere. Shira ng'aha ama-host ari kuri urwo rubuga webhooks zishobora gushikako - Node-RED, seriveri y'ibiganiro - imwe ku murongo, nk'izina canke aderesi, hamwe na port kugira ngo iyo port yonyene yemerwe. Ubusa: nta na kimwe. Abayobozi b'urubuga bonyene ni bo bashobora guhindura uru rutonde.
account-webhook-desc: Aderesi imwe WeKan imenyesha igihe umuntu yinjiye canke igihe konti nshasha iremwe. Nta kintu na kimwe kirungikwa gushika igikorwa kiri munsi gishizweko akamenyetso. Irungika igikorwa, izina ry'ukoresha n'umwanya; shira akamenyetso ku bindi bibanza gusa iyo uwakira abikeneye.
activity-recovery-cancel-older-prompt: Hagarika amatangazo yose arindiriye y'ibikorwa vya kera kuruta imisi ingahe?
vcs-synced-from: Vyahujwe bivuye kuri %s: uyugurure kandi uyugare ngaho.
vcs-synced-issue: Iyi ngorane irahujwe: uyugurure kandi uyugare mu bubiko bwayo.
sync-write-back: Andika amahinduka usubize kuri GitLab: umutwe, insiguro, ivyiyumviro, ugufunga n'ugusubira kwugurura
email-bounces-description: Ivyo WeKan ikora ku meyili zigaruka: aderese yanditswe nabi, agasandugu kuzuye, inyishu y'uko umuntu adahari, ukwitotomba kuri spam. Ubwoko bwose bufise ibikorwa vyabwo, bikorwa iyo bwagarutse incuro nk'izo.
email-bounces-category-hard-desc: Aderese ntibaho: ikosa ryo kwandika, konti yafuswe, domene itazwi.
email-bounces-category-soft-desc: Ntiyashitse ubu: agasandugu kuzuye, seriveri irahuze. Izinshi zikurikirana gusa nizo zivuga ikintu.
email-bounces-category-auto-reply-desc: Inyishu z'uko adahari, ari mu kiruhuko canke z'urubuga rw'amatike. Imeyili yarashitse.
email-bounces-category-complaint-desc: Uwakiriye yashize iyo meyili mu za spam.
email-bounces-ses-description: Muri Amazon SES, rungika amatangazo ya Bounce na Complaint, n'itegeko ryo kwakira ku aderese WeKan irungikirako, ku kiganiro ca SNS, hanyuma wiyandikishe iyi aderese kuri co biciye kuri HTTPS:
email-bounces-ses-topics: ARN z'ibiganiro vya SNS vyemewe, kimwe ku murongo
email-bounces-clear-hint: Kwibagira ibigaruka vy'iyi aderese no kuyirungikira imeyili kandi
email-bounce-invalid-topic: Ico si ARN y'ikiganiro ca SNS.
email-bounces-providers-description: Nimba WeKan irungika biciye kuri kimwe muri ibi bikorwa, gicanire, uhe ico gikorwa iyi aderese ya webhook ku vyabaye vyaco vya meyili zigarutse n'ukwitotomba kuri spam, hanyuma ushiremwo ngaha urufunguzo gisinyisha, canke ijambo ry'ibanga washize muri aderese nka https://user:password@… canke ?secret=…
email-bounce-provider-secret-required: Igikorwa cacanywe gikeneye urufunguzo rwaco rwo gusinya canke ijambo ry'ibanga.
activity-pub-enabled: Ivyapa vya bose bishira ahabona ibikorwa vy'amakarata yavyo kuri fediverse (ActivityPub)
activity-pub-desc: Kirazimye ubusanzwe. Iyo cakije, ikibaho cose ca bose gishobora gukurikirwa kuva kuri Mastodon n'izindi seriveri za fediverse nka @board-<id> kuri aderese y'iyi WeKan, kandi ibikorwa bishasha vy'amakarata bigera ku bagikurikira. Ni ivyo gusoma gusa: nta kintu seriveri ya fediverse irungika gihindura icapa, kandi ivyapa vyihariye ntibigera bishirwa ahabona.
caldav-sync-desc: Shira amatariki ntarengwa y'amakarata y'iki capa mu kirangamisi - Nextcloud Calendar canke ikindi kirangamisi ca CalDAV. Itariki ntarengwa yimuriwe mu kirangamisi isubira ku ikarata. Koresha ijambo ry'ibanga rya porogaramu, atari iryawe bwite.
caldav-invalid-url: Aderese y'ikirangamisi itegerezwa kuba aderese ya http:// canke https://, itarimwo izina ry'ukoresha canke ijambo ry'ibanga.
caldav-not-linked: Banza ubike aderese y'ikirangamisi hanyuma wakize uguhuza.
webdav-storage-description: Bika ivyometse mu bubiko bwa dosiye kuri seriveri ya WebDAV - Nextcloud Files, ownCloud canke iyindi yose. Koresha ijambo ry'ibanga rya porogaramu ryakorewe WeKan. Seriveri iri ku rubuga rwa WeKan nyene ishobora gukoreshwa ng'aha, kuko umuyobozi w'urubuga wenyene ari we ashinga iyi aderese.
sqrl-desc: Bisanzwe bizimije. Iyo bihaye, urupapuro rwo kwinjira rutanga SQRL, kandi abanywanyi babanza kwongerako akaranga kabo ka SQRL mu Bigenwa vy'umunywanyi. SQRL isaba ko WeKan iba kuri aderese ya https://.
sqrl-scan: Soma kode ukoresheje porogarama yawe ya SQRL, canke ufungure umukiriya wawe wa SQRL kuri iki gikoresho.
sqrl-expired: Iyi kode ya SQRL yararengeje igihe. Subira utangure.
sqrl-needs-https: SQRL isaba ko WeKan iba kuri aderese ya https://.
sqrl-description: Injira ukoresheje akaranga kawe ka SQRL aho gukoresha ijambo ry'ibanga. Kongereko hano rimwe ukoresheje umukiriya wawe wa SQRL; ushobora kugikura hano igihe cose.
sqrl-disabled-by-client: Kwinjira ukoresheje SQRL vyazimijwe kuri iyi konti biciye ku mukiriya wawe wa SQRL. Bisubire uhe ngaho ukoresheje kode yawe yo gutabara.
sqrl-only-on: Umukiriya wawe wa SQRL yugaye iyi konti ku SQRL gusa: ubundi buryo bwose bwo kwinjira buranswe.
sqrl-hardlock-on: Umukiriya wawe wa SQRL yugaye iyi konti burundu: gusubiramwo ijambo ry'ibanga no guhindura imeyili biranswe.
sqrl-only: Iyi konti yinjira ikoresheje SQRL gusa.
sqrl-hardlock: Iyi konti yugawe kuri SQRL: ntishobora gusubizwa canke guhindurwa mu bundi buryo.
windows-sso-failed: Kwinjira ukoresheje Windows vyanse. Konte yawe ya Windows ishobora kuba itemewe ng'aha.
